title: Commercial - Retail Trainee

reasons.love: Partly commercial; much of the role is back-office support.
reasons.good_at: Some overlap via F26 (reporting); the domain experience the JD wants is not evidenced.
reasons.needs: Stable employer, but the JD names no development path.
reasons.paid: Estimate: the posting states no salary. about THB 40,000-50,000 per month for a Bangkok graduate programme. for a comparable Bangkok graduate role.

summary: Good commercial fit with a clear growth path.
jd_text: Cartier Thailand is hiring for Commercial - Retail Trainee in Bangkok, Thailand. You will work with cross-functional teams, analyse sales and customer data, prepare weekly reports and present recommendations to managers. Requirements: bachelor's degree in any field (2026-2027 graduates welcome); good command of English and Thai; strong Excel; a team player who learns quickly. We offer structured training, mentoring and a clear career path.
